messages:
Maya: :rotating_light: incident-bot triggered: high p95 inference latency reported on prod-gpu-pool-2. Alert
incident-bot: alert inference.latency.p95 > 300ms for 5m — paging oncall
oncall-bot: Paging @maya (SRE oncall) and @alex
Maya: picking this up — initial checks: prometheus shows p95 spike to ~420ms, p50 stable ~60ms. Customers: a few API 504s in the last 15m per request logs.
Alex: I'm seeing repeated KV cache eviction spikes in the runtime logs: `kv_cache.evictions: 240` and lots of `cache_miss` immediately before latency jumps.
Maya: wow. Could be batcher behavior + cache churn with long seq. Sam, any deploys in last 30m?
Sam: no deploys. Infra alert for node OOM about 35m ago but recovered.
Alex: posting logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T18:12:03Z] runtime: request id=ab12, seq_len=2048, kv_cache.evictions=3, kernel_exec=120ms
[2026-03-14T18:12:04Z] runtime: request id=ab13, seq_len=2048, kv_cache.evictions=4, kernel_exec=380ms
[2026-03-14T18:12:05Z] runtime: batcher: merged=12, latency=310ms
```
Maya: hypothesis: large-seq requests causing repeated KV cache evictions — runtime thrashes and batcher increases latency. Impact: several customer calls timed out (seen in 5 customer sessions).
Alex: For immediate mitigation: reduce batcher max_batch_size to 8 for the affected pool and add a soft-eviction threshold. Can we push a config change?
Maya: agree. Sam, can you roll a config change to prod-gpu-pool-2? Keep it as a canary for 1 node and watch for error rate regressions.
Sam: will do. Pushing update to rollout group `gpu-pool-2-canary-1` now.
infra-bot: deploy started: rollout gpu-pool-2-canary-1 (change: batcher.max_batch_size=8, kv_cache.soft_evict_threshold=0.75)
Alex: while that's rolling, can we suppress the noisy alert rule inference.latency.p95 for 15m and instead create a signature for `kv_cache.evictions > 10 in 5m`? We want to avoid paging for known thrash pattern.
Maya: yes — suppress p95 paging, but keep dashboard and alert for escalation if 15m window continues. Create new log rule and a regex to catch evictions: `kv_cache\.evictions=\d+` then aggregation.
Sam: suppressing paging for `inference.latency.p95` with temporary responder: `sre-temporary-silence-15m`
oncall-bot: alert rule `inference.latency.p95` silenced for 15 minutes by Sam
Alex: adding a new log-based alert: name `runtime.kv_cache_thrash_signature` query: `parse "kv_cache.evictions=%{NUMBER:evict}" | evict > 10` and add tag `known-eviction-thrash` and set severity=warning
Maya: include suggested runbook: check `kv_cache.size` and `batcher.max_batch_size`. If signature fires, recommend immediate canary adjustment and notify SRE channel — don't page unless errors > 1% or customer-impacting 5xxs.
Alex: I'm also adding a regex filter to the old noisy rule: exclude lines matching `seq_len<100`? actually exclude `user-agent: internal-test` — we saw a noisy internal integration skewing counts. Regex: `user-agent:\s*internal-test`
Maya: good catch. Also create a dashboard widget showing evictions, p95, batcher.size, and active_batches per node. Put it under `SRE / Incidents / KV Cache Thrash` and link in runbook.
Sam: rollout finished on canary. Initial numbers: p95 down from 420ms to 230ms on canary node. Evictions dropped 70%.
Maya: ok push to remaining nodes with gradual ramp if metrics hold for 10m.
Alex: after-action items for postmortem: add long-term mitigation (more resilient KV eviction policy, per-request seq_len caps), formalize the `runtime.kv_cache_thrash_signature` and tune thresholds, update alert runbook and add dashboard.
Maya: assigning tasks: Alex -> implement signature + dashboard, Sam -> rollout plan and automation for canary, me (Maya) -> update runbook and coordinate customer comms.
Sam: customer comms? any customer facing incidents to notify? We had 5 sessions affected, low-traffic customers but still need TTR note.
Maya: I'll draft a short incident blurb, include mitigation and ETA.
Alex: marking this thread for follow-up handoff to next oncall at 1951234800 (in ~6m).
Maya: handing off to @alex for overnight follow-up. I'm going offline in 10. :thumbsup:
alex: ack. will monitor dashboard and tune signature as needed.
Maya: thanks team. Closing paging loop — putting final notes in the incident tracker. :white_check_mark:
